description: Get a single customer by their ID. `birth_date` (date only, no year-of-birth guarantee beyond what the buyer entered) is present only when the customer supplied it, and is read-only: UpdateCustomer has no such field. It is personal data — redact:true masks it along with name, phone, email and note.

redact.description: Use redact:true when the task does not need personal data (e.g. counting or aggregating orders) — personal fields (name, phone, email, date of birth, delivery address and its parts, notes) are replaced with "[redacted]". Applies to the response only; request bodies are never redacted. Default false.

name: get_customer
title: Get customer
